author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to set up Mailchimp email marketing from scratch so you can build an email list and send a real newsletter, even if you're not tech savvy. 
⚡️ Start your email newsletter here! ➜ https://mailchimp.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you’ll create your account the right way with a real domain (not Gmail) and you’ll understand the main points of the different plans that Mailchimp offers. 

Next, you’ll grow subscribers fast by building a simple signup landing page inside Mailchimp, including how the editor works and limitations on mobile design. 

Then, you’ll build your first newsletter. You'll learn the email editor (different from the landing page), and then test your message to make sure it all looks right. 

Afterward, you’ll fix a rookie mistake—ending up in the spam folder—by authenticating your domain in Mailchimp so your emails don’t land in junk.

title: Mailchimp Tutorial for Beginners – Learn Email Marketing in 2026
